title: Fine-Grained Head Pose Estimation Without Keypoints
metricDefinition: The model estimates intrinsic Euler yaw, pitch, and roll from a single RGB image; Face-Fit instead aggregates baseline-relative absolute angles over an answer.

extractionLocations.description: Intrinsic Euler yaw, pitch, and roll prediction definition.
Algorithm mean-angle error results; these are measurement errors, not behavior limits.

measurements.definition: Yaw, pitch, and roll predicted directly from image intensities.
measurements.calculationMethod: Joint binned pose classification and regression.
notes: Per-image absolute orientation is not baseline-relative answer p95.

measurements.definition: Algorithm prediction error against benchmark labels.
measurements.calculationMethod: Mean angle error by Euler component and combined result.
notes: Algorithm error must never become a behavior penalty boundary.

reportedFindings.summary: The paper validates a single-image method for estimating yaw, pitch, and roll and reports benchmark error.
Benchmark error quantifies model accuracy only.

faceFitMappings.reason: The unit matches, but per-image intrinsic yaw is not baseline-relative absolute p95 over an answer.
The unit matches, but per-image intrinsic pitch is not baseline-relative absolute p95 over an answer.
The unit matches, but per-image intrinsic roll is not baseline-relative absolute p95 over an answer.

thresholdAssessment.reason: Reported angle errors evaluate the estimator and cannot define acceptable interview behavior.

limitations: Head orientation is distinct from ocular gaze.
Benchmark images and Face-Fit webcam sessions have different aggregation and deployment conditions.
